pilot.rule_found_in_code_or_release: WN18 is the induced subgraph of WordNet 3.0's 18-relation graph on its entity set (151437 of 151442 triples rebuilt; 58 induced triples absent), so the entity set is the rule; but 34393 of the 40943 synsets have < 15 triples in that graph and 38117 in the release itself; no degree threshold reproduces the set (best single-pass Jaccard 0.597, 15-core empty); entity ids are bare offsets, which WordNet reuses across POS: 161 WN18 entities merge triples of two different synsets
pilot.rule_stated_in_paper: 'we filtered out the synsets appearing in less that 15 triplets' over the 18 relation types, giving 40,943 synsets (Mach Learn 2014); WN18RR keeps WN18's entities and drops inverse relations (11 relations)
